# Hash-locked bootstrap for the CI Python environment.
#
# Installed with `pip install --require-hashes` so the resolver refuses any
# package whose contents do not match a hash listed here. Pinning versions
# alone is not enough — PyPI release files can in principle be replaced;
# hashes make the supply chain tamper-evident.
#
# To regenerate (e.g. when bumping pip/pipenv/wheel):
#   echo -e "pip==X.Y\npipenv==X.Y\nwheel==X.Y" > bootstrap.in
#   uv pip compile --generate-hashes --no-header -o bootstrap-requirements.txt bootstrap.in
# (or `pip-compile --generate-hashes` from pip-tools, same output format).

certifi==2026.5.20 \
    --hash=sha256:3c52e209ba0a4ad7aebe60436a4ab349c39e1e602e8c134221e546902ad25897 \
    --hash=sha256:69dea482ab64caa7b9f6aba1c6bf48bb6a5448d1c0f1b17ab42ad8c763a5344d
    # via pipenv
distlib==0.4.2 \
    --hash=sha256:baeb401c90f27acd15c4861ae0847d1e731c27ac3dbf4210643ba61fa1e813db \
    --hash=sha256:ca4cb11e5d746b5ec13c199cbf19ae27a241f89702b54e153a74332955446067
    # via virtualenv
filelock==3.29.1 \
    --hash=sha256:85199dfd706869641b72b2e8955d5416a4b2b7dc4b0e8e6d97b4cc1299a6983b \
    --hash=sha256:d97e6b1b9757569626c58caa07dc4beb1613f4a2938b1e8cc81afca398906c9e
    # via
    #   python-discovery
    #   virtualenv
packaging==26.2 \
    --hash=sha256:5fc45236b9446107ff2415ce77c807cee2862cb6fac22b8a73826d0693b0980e \
    --hash=sha256:ff452ff5a3e828ce110190feff1178bb1f2ea2281fa2075aadb987c2fb221661
    # via
    #   pipenv
    #   wheel
pip==26.1.2 \
    --hash=sha256:382ff9f685ee3bc25864f820aa50505825f10f5458ffff07e30a6d96e5715cab \
    --hash=sha256:f49cd134c61cf2fd75e0ce2676db03e4054504a5a4986d00f8299ae632dc4605
pipenv==2026.6.2 \
    --hash=sha256:60ebe825a4fa061573b43006174bbcda2a2baae1a6f07720cb17d96db1b1b3af \
    --hash=sha256:fe513e97f3fc7027df22647aaf2b9de892f345f7e56dc0422e70b1213d641400
platformdirs==4.10.0 \
    --hash=sha256:31e761a6a0ca04faf7353ea759bdba55652be214725111e5aac52dfa29d4bef7 \
    --hash=sha256:fb516cdb12eb0d857d0cd85a7c57cea4d060bee4578d6cf5a14dfdf8cbf8784a
    # via
    #   python-discovery
    #   virtualenv
python-discovery==1.4.0 \
    --hash=sha256:26ed78d703e234879a66244c7d4114563fb13ec5cd30a2d1357e5fb4850782da \
    --hash=sha256:eb8bc7daad3c226c147e45bb4e970a1feb1bf4048ee178e6db59e197b8010ce3
    # via virtualenv
setuptools==82.0.1 \
    --hash=sha256:7d872682c5d01cfde07da7bccc7b65469d3dca203318515ada1de5eda35efbf9 \
    --hash=sha256:a59e362652f08dcd477c78bb6e7bd9d80a7995bc73ce773050228a348ce2e5bb
